text:
First trip to Okinawa? In Naha you don't need a car.
The monorail reaches Kokusai-dori from the airport
in 13 to 16 minutes, for ¥290 to ¥320.
The car question only starts when you head north 👇

👉 Kokusai-dori, Asahibashi or Omoromachi? Guess:
https://japanbystation.com/naha-where-to-stay-do-you-need-a-car

🏮 Kokusai-dori (our pick)
Covered streets lead to Makishi Public Market.
Shuri Castle is 11 minutes from Makishi station.
The main street stays lively at night,
so ask for a room off it.

🚌 Asahibashi
The closest stop to the airport: 11 minutes, ¥290.
Naha Bus Terminal is next to the station.

🛍️ Omoromachi
Newer and calmer, with T Galleria by DFS by exit 1.
Easy with kids, and Makishi is only 3 minutes away.

🚗 And the car?
Churaumi Aquarium's site says about two hours
by car from the airport, about three by express bus.
So skip the car in Naha.
Rent one only for the days you go north.

👉 The market where they cook the fish you just bought:
